{{Quote|Wynssa made the arrangements for our honeymoon. I still don't know the name of the world, but I will never forget it.|Soontir Fel|<ref name="RS25" />}}
Following their [[Wedding of Soontir Fel and Wynssa Starflare|wedding]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] and [[Syal Antilles Fel|Wynssa Starflare]] spent a two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]] honeymoon on this resort '''world'''.<ref name="RS25" /> Starflare arranged the couple's honeymoon, which was paid for by [[Fusion Holodrama]] in the hope that she would read one of the company's scripts during their stay.<ref name="RS25" /> The couple spent a blissful [[Time/Legends|time]] with each other on this unspoiled world,<ref name="FF122">{{FactFile|122|WYN 1-4|Wynssa Starflare}}</ref> full of life and innocence,<ref name="RS25" /> and far from the strife of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FF122" /> Fel never learned the name of this world, although it rekindled his love of nature.<ref name="RS25" />
